# NoAway

> NoAway is a desktop productivity app for macOS 11 (Big Sur) or later and Windows 10/11 (64-bit). NoAway keeps your computer active while it is switched on. Whether Teams or Slack show you as Available also depends on permissions and on the conditions listed in Help. It prevents system idle at the OS level and does not interact with, inject into, or modify Teams or Slack. Keep Active runs on your computer and does not send keystrokes, screen contents, chats, or files. Network use is for licensing: activation sends your license key, purchase email, and a device id; periodic license checks also send app version, platform, activity mode, which of Teams/Slack/Zoom/Discord appear to be running, and how many seconds Keep Active was on that day—so we can validate the one-device license and understand product usage. One license works on one device. Updates are emailed to buyers with a direct download link. One-time launch price €4.99 (EUR)—no subscription, no free trial. Support: support@noaway.app

Base-URL: https://noaway.app/
